name: app-three-fintech-onboarding-screens-staggered-with-italic-serif-headline
title: Three Fintech Onboarding Screens Staggered
whatItIs: A white page with an Onboarding Screen pill, a headline mixing light sans and bold italic serif 'Banking Experience.', a paragraph, and three phones staggered diagonally down the page showing Banking Made Simple, Your Financial Growth Hub and Pay Your Saved Bills Instantly, each with a blue-grey gradient, cards and Skip and Next buttons.
whatItMeans: A diagonal stagger gives a sequence rhythm, and the same gradient and buttons hold the three steps together.
techniques: Blue-grey gradient rising from the base of each screen
Skip and Next button pair on each screen
Step counters at the top right
Arc of icons for bill types

vocabulary.definition: Items placed along a diagonal path.
A secondary and primary button at the base of onboarding.
A fraction such as 2/4 showing onboarding progress.
